name: pairs_plus_vix_overlay_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: Standard pairs trading (e.g., HDFCBANK/ICICIBANK) is enhanced by a VIX overlay: only enter pairs trades when VIX is in a 'calm' regime (< 16). During low-VIX environments, correlation between sector pairs is higher and spread mean reversion is faster and more reliable. When VIX > 20, correlations break down and pairs diverge for fundamental reasons. The VIX filter reduces the number of trades but dramatically improves win rate. Edge persists because most pairs traders don't use a vol-regime filter.
stock_filter: pre-defined pairs: HDFCBANK/ICICIBANK, TCS/INFY, RELIANCE/ONGC, SBIN/BANKBARODA

indicators.name: spread_halflife
indicators.formula: ADF regression halflife on rolling 500 bars

exit.trailing_stop: move stop to BE when z-score crosses ±1.0
exit.signal_exit: spread_zscore crosses 0 OR vix crosses 18 (vol rising, exit early)

filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.event_filter: skip if either stock has results; skip on RBI day
other_filters: exit if VIX crosses 18 during trade — regime changing

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — pairs with VIX filter is a known concept but underimplemented

weaknesses: VIX < 16 is a strict filter — may only be active 30-40% of trading days
Two-leg cost is double (~25 bps per pair trade round trip)
Calm-regime mean reversion edge is small — relies on high win rate with small winners
prior_art: Pairs trading with volatility regime filter — enhancing Gatev et al. with regime overlay
notes: This is the 'quality over quantity' version of pairs trading. Fewer trades, higher quality.
